extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet identifies the exact target as SS8050W from TWGMC and labels it TRANSISTOR(NPN). No datasheet revision is stated.

Page 2 contains usable typical plots. Curve points are sparse approximate manual digitizations of visible traces at labeled or clearly readable grid positions. No points were interpolated between plotted observations.
All plotted curve values were transcribed in SI units: currents from mA to A, capacitance from pF to F, and frequency from MHz to Hz.

The hFE(1) table row is a guaranteed 120 minimum and 400 maximum at IC = 100 mA; the hFE(2) row is a guaranteed 40 minimum at IC = 800 mA. These bounds are kept separate from the typical hFE curve and were not converted to typical values.
The VCE(sat) and VBE(sat) table values are guaranteed maximums at IC = 800 mA and IB = 80 mA. The page 2 saturation curves are typical and remain separate from those maximum table entries.
No tabulated Cobo or Cibo value is present. The page 2 capacitance-versus-VCB plot is retained as a typical curve, while the required tabulated capacitance fields are null.
The page 2 typical characteristics do not state temperature on the plots. The electrical-characteristics table heading states TA = 25 degC unless otherwise specified.

Absolute maximum ratings include VCBO = 40 V, VCEO = 25 V, VEBO = 5 V, IC = 1.5 A, PC = 0.2 W, and Tj = 150 degC; the strict extraction schema has no fields for these except the V(BR)CEO value represented by specs.vceo.
The supplied three-page PDF has page 1 electrical data, page 2 typical characteristics, and page 3 package outline.
